name: bout
title: Bout
description: A boxing gym theme printed like a letterpress fight poster: poster-yellow stock, wood-type black and red capitals, and a weekly timetable set as a fight bill, one centred line per class with stars between.

tokens.--font-poster: condensed wood-type capitals: the site title, page headlines, class names on the bill, coach names, section headings
tokens.--font-slab: slab serif for body text and the small set lines: menu, day names, time, coach and level, discipline, buttons
tokens.--weight-poster: weight asked of the poster face (Impact has one weight and is never made bolder)
tokens.--weight-slab: weight of the slab set lines, the class time, the trial note and the first column of tables
tokens.--text-s: small slab capitals and set lines: menu, the bill heading, time, coach and level, discipline, buttons, footer notes, table headings
tokens.--text-m: base body size and the day names on the bill
tokens.--text-l: intro line under a headline, h3 in text, the site name in the footer
tokens.--text-xl: coach names in the list, h2 in text and the timetable pointer heading on a coach page
tokens.--text-head: page headlines; the 404 figure is set at one and a half times this size
tokens.--text-hero: the headline of a page that carries the weekly bill, set across the full measure as the poster's top line
tokens.--text-bout: class names on the bill, sized from the width of each day's bill
tokens.--leading-poster: line height of the poster capitals (close, as wood type is set, with room for accents and cedillas between stacked lines)
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small slab capitals
tokens.--color-bg: poster-yellow stock: the page, and the lettering on the black ticket buttons and Today flag
tokens.--color-text: wood-type black ink: body text, headlines, every other class name, links, stars, the ticket buttons and focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: footer notes, the no-classes line, the empty message, the menu hover underline
tokens.--color-accent: fight-bill red, for large capitals only: every second class name on a bill, every second coach name, the 404 figure, the timetable pointer heading
tokens.--color-rule: the printer's rules: masthead and footer double rules, day bill rules, list rules, table heading rule, the current menu underline
tokens.--color-panel: faint wash behind code and under table rows
tokens.--measure: maximum width of running text and the trial note
tokens.--bill-min: narrowest a day's bill may get before the week drops a column
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between a class name and its set line
tokens.--space-2: small gap: around stars, inside the masthead and labels
tokens.--space-3: base step: page gutter and gaps inside a bill
tokens.--space-4: gap between page parts and between bills side by side
tokens.--space-5: gap between rows of bills, above the footer and around the trial note
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the heavy rules: masthead, top of each bill, list entries, blockquotes, photo frames
tokens.--rule-thin: thickness of the thin rules and of link underlines
tokens.--tap-target: minimum touch height of menu links, buttons and pagination links
tokens.--photo-width: width of a coach's portrait on their own page
tokens.--photo-ratio: coach portrait shape as width divided by height (0.8 is 4:5)
